groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: 🟡 Mixed
groups.explanation:
Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.860% and the 10Y at 5.066%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 6 consecutive sessions. Brent is +0.16% at about $99.41, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-2/100, stable →). The tension is between persistent semiconductor momentum, supportive options positioning, semiconductor/AI leaders holding above their earnings AVWAPs on the supportive side and elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership on the headwind side.

The important trigger is US10Y at 5.00%. A sustained break above roughly 5.00–5.05% while the 2Y remains near 4.86% would materially weaken the setup, especially if semiconductor leadership also deteriorates. A retreat in the 10Y with continued semiconductor strength would reinforce the positive setup. Elevated consolidation risk is tempering the directional setup.
